page.layout: One page of text, full width at top with running head and page number line; below it a centred heading "PARS" and a woodcut of a flower basket (no text). No margin notes.

main_text.p: gmata sed inter humanas notitias censeri debe-re; id vero istorum somnium est sic ab omni ratione alienum, ut de eo quemquam ex idoneis, probatisque Dialecticis auctoribus vel vigilantem unquam vel etiam dormientem cogitasse non sit verisimile.
main_text.head: PARS

page.notes: Running head line reads "DEMONSTRATIONE. Pars 1. 91 Cap.13." with "Pars 1." and "Cap.13." in italic/small type; the page number 91 and the chapter marker Cap. 13 are set at the head. The woodcut of a flower basket is an illustration and is not transcribed. The first word "gmata" is a fragment (likely "dogmata") and is kept as printed.
